method: Existing build_load_report telemetry derivation and host_summary; complete two-second intervals inside exact named windows. Raw writeback bracket uses first sample at/after phase end and first at/after 30 seconds later; actual measured duration and raw sector counters preserved. Busy-percent excluded. No causal attribution from observational comparison. Subphase boundaries are reconstructed from execution_started_at plus docker_build_and_push_ms, not independently timestamped events; allow small unmeasured handoff gaps. Host windows describe concurrent work, not individual-request resource use.
